استلذوا (form X)
# اِسْتَلَذُّوا (istalaḏḏū) /is.ta.lað.ðuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَلَذَّ (istalaḏḏa)
# اُسْتُلِذُّوا (ustuliḏḏū) /us.tu.lið.ðuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَلَذَّ (istalaḏḏa)
# اِسْتَلِذُّوا (istaliḏḏū) /is.ta.lið.ðuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَلَذَّ (istalaḏḏa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
